def make_min_max_attributes(validators, min_attr, max_attr) -> dict:
    """Return a dictionary of minimum and maximum attributes based on a list
    of validators. If either minimum or maximum values are not present in any
    of the validator objects that attribute will be omitted.

    :param validators list: A list of `Marshmallow` validator objects. Each
        objct is inspected for a minimum and maximum values
    :param min_attr string: The OpenAPI attribute for the minimum value
    :param max_attr string: The OpenAPI attribute for the maximum value
    """
    attributes = {}
    min_list = [validator.min for validator in validators if validator.min is not None]
    max_list = [validator.max for validator in validators if validator.max is not None]

## Summary

The issue was caused by corruption in the `DEFAULT_FIELD_MAPPING` dictionary in `/testbed/src/apispec/ext/marshmallow/field_converter.py`. 

The corruption changed the correct field type mappings to incorrect values:
- `Integer` was changed from `("integer", None)` to `("string", None)`
- `Float`, `Number`, `Decimal` were changed from `("number", None)` to `("string", None)`
- `Boolean` was changed from `("boolean", None)` to `("string", None)`
- `TimeDelta` was changed from `("integer", None)` to `("string", None)`
- Several fields lost their format specifications: `UUID`, `DateTime`, `Date`, `Email`, `URL`, `IP`, `IPv4`, `IPv6` all had their format values stripped (changed from e.g., `("string", "uuid")` to `("string", None)`)

This caused all Marshmallow fields to be incorrectly converted to the `string` type with no format specification, leading to the test failures.

The fix was to restore the file from git using `git checkout HEAD -- src/apispec/ext/marshmallow/field_converter.py`, which restored the correct field type mappings. All 12 specified failing tests now pass, and all 277 tests in the marshmallow extension test files pass.

commands.command: cd /testbed && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || echo "No git history available"

cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate testbed && pytest --disable-warnings --color=no --tb=no --verbose tests/test_ext_marshmallow_field.py tests/test_ext_marshmallow_openapi.py 2>&1 | tail -30
